_about: The Place Department's birds in the Hawkes Gen library (hawkesgen/clients/js/hawkesgen-folders.mjs): one entity per bird model, its model slot the FBX. Picks write back to the same file. Wallit is Gen character3d entity theplacedepartment/wallit (not folder-mapped): bake export/fbx to Assets/Art/Wallit/Wallit.fbx, then Tools → Wallit → Build Prefab. Slice is Gen character3d entity theplacedepartment/slice (not folder-mapped): bake export/fbx to Assets/Art/Slice/Slice.fbx, then Tools → Slice → Build Prefab. Yo Bot and Spider Bot are Gen robot entities theplacedepartment/yo-bot and theplacedepartment/spider-bot: export/fbx goes to Assets/Resources/Models/Bots/YoBot.fbx and SpiderBot.fbx, painted skins from Tools/Bots/paint.py, then Tools → Bots → Build Prefabs.
